meta.title: Math 140 — Your Thinking, Your AI Sidekick

voice.design: male, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent
voice.direction: Warm, curious conversational energy; natural pauses, never announcer shouting.

voice.design: male, elderly, low pitch, american accent
voice.direction: Calm encouraging mentor; kindly humor, no condescension or sarcasm.

voice.design: female, young adult, high pitch, american accent
voice.direction: Bright curious sidekick; light playful delivery, intelligible and never screeching.

scenes.title: The Big Question

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Could AI help us learn math, while we still do the thinking?

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: I can be your study sidekick! Where do we start?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: With your questions. Learning is a team effort.

scenes.direction: BOT floats into the classroom; welcoming nods.

scenes.title: The Five Rules

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Our Math one-forty sidekick has five ground rules.

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Let’s make them easy to remember.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: One: build your own shapes.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Two: write your own proofs.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: Could I show a practice example?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Yes! Then let the student try.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Three: ask for hints, not finished answers.

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: A good hint helps you choose the next step.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Four: explain your own reasoning.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Five: quizzes are your solo mission.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: Study buddy now. Cheerleader at quiz time!

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Exactly. You’re here to help us learn.

scenes.direction: Five readable rule cards; celebrate independent thinking.

scenes.title: Where Students Struggle

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: What makes a math problem feel confusing?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: New words, tricky wording, and what the symbols mean.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: Let’s turn those symbols into a picture.

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: That can help. Then explain the idea in your own words.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: So understanding matters more than copying an answer?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Yes. Make the meaning yours.

scenes.direction: Show a triangle diagram with base and perpendicular height.

scenes.title: When AI Gets It Wrong

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: I got two plus two equals five. Wait…

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Let’s check it together.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: How do we catch an AI mistake?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Try a small example. Count two, then two more.

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Four! Students and teachers both need to check AI’s work.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: Thanks! Checking beats guessing.

scenes.direction: Count four dots together; correct the mistake kindly.

scenes.title: The Experiment

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: How could we test our study sidekick?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: See whether it helps with vocabulary, reading problems, and understanding.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Would everyone need to use it?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: We can offer a choice, with an approved practice activity.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: A practice adventure! I’m ready.

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: And we’ll ask what helped, and what didn’t.

scenes.direction: Show a small optional pilot, not a proven research result.

scenes.title: The Final Verdict

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Would you try a small pilot?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Yes. Let’s learn from it together.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: Study-sidekick mode: ready!

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: With students steering the thinking.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: I’ll bring the hints. You bring the ideas.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Think first. Ask for help. Check the work. That’s learning together.

scenes.direction: All three face the audience; end on learning together.
